:::{#exr-log-partition-derivative}
#### The derivative of the log-partition function is the mean of the statistic

In the setting of @exr-log-partition-normalization,
differentiate both sides of

$$
\expf{\logpartitionf{\natparam}}
= \int \basemeasuref{\rvar} \, \expf{\natparam \, \statf{\rvar}} \, d\rvar
$$

with respect to $\natparam$.
Assume that the [derivative](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mds/calculus-derivatives.html#def-derivative) of the
[integral](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mds/measures-integrals.html#def-integral)
is the integral of the derivative.
Show that

$$
\dif{\logpartitionf{\natparam}}{\natparam} = \E{\statf{\Rvar}}.
$$

:::
